item.title: len
item.description: Returns the length of the raw template. This function does not generate a change. Function template.len() Arguments None Return value Returns the length of the raw template. Example This code uses len() to return the length of the template: tpl = template("Hello {name}!"); tpl.len(); Return value in JSON format 13

item.title: render
item.description: Renders a template using the current scope, unless a scope is provided. This function does not generate a change, unless the template code itself modifies data in the target scope. Function template.render([scope]) Arguments Argument Type Description scope thing (optional) The scope in which to evaluate the template. Defaults to the current scope if omitted. Return value Returns the rendered str value.
